meta.name: video-ad-specs
meta.description: Video ad creation with exact platform-specific specs for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn. Covers dimensions, duration limits, AIDA framework, and caption requirements. Use for: video ads, social media ads, paid media creative, video marketing, ad production. Triggers: video ad, social media ad, tiktok ad, instagram ad, youtube ad, facebook ad, linkedin ad, video creative, ad specs, paid media, video marketing, ad production, reels ad, stories ad, pre roll, bumper ad

copy.tagline: 按各平台规格创建视频广告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为不同社交媒体平台制作符合规格的视频广告。
copy.tagline_en: Create video ads with platform-specific specs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create video ads that meet exact specs for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and LinkedIn.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据平台规格（如 TikTok、Instagram、YouTube 等）生成视频广告创意，包括尺寸、时长、AIDA 框架和字幕要求，并调用 inference.sh CLI 工具生成视频。
howto.when: 当你提到“视频广告”、“社交媒体广告”、“TikTok 广告”等关键词，或要求制作特定平台的视频广告时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个 TikTok 竖屏视频广告，15秒，展示产品开箱。
生成一个 YouTube 6秒 bumper 广告，突出品牌 logo。
say.note: Claude 会使用 16:9 比例和 6 秒时长限制。

say.text: 为 Facebook 信息流广告添加字幕，静音观看。
say.note: Claude 会调用字幕生成工具并强调高对比度。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate video ad creatives with platform-specific specs (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, etc.), covering dimensions, duration limits, AIDA framework, and caption requirements, and invoke inference.sh CLI tools to produce videos.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "video ad", "social media ad", "TikTok ad", etc., or ask to create video ads for a specific platform.

say_en.text: Create a 15-second vertical TikTok ad showing product unboxing.
say_en.note: Claude will follow TikTok specs and generate CLI commands.

say_en.text: Generate a 6-second YouTube bumper ad highlighting the brand logo.
say_en.note: Claude will use 16:9 ratio and 6-second duration.

say_en.text: Add captions to a Facebook feed ad for silent viewing.
say_en.note: Claude will invoke caption tool and emphasize high contrast.
